nodes.label: Zeabur
nodes.summary: Primary PaaS: Brais's always-on apps, the Hermes engine and their databases run as Kubernetes workloads on one dedicated Frankfurt server rented through Zeabur.
details: Account plan DEVELOPER (Dev $5/mo) plus one dedicated server (~$21-22/mo): fixed plan, no usage billing, no Project Budget, so no server-side spend cap exists (dashboard check 2026-06-20)
7 projects exist today (CLI, 2026-10-06): hermes-eu, grow-shop, social-agenda, biglobster, flywell, experiencianatural, B_Browser. All sit on the single Frankfurt server

Decision notes say 'all 6 projects': the six migrated and exported are hermes-eu, grow-shop, social-agenda, biglobster, flywell, experiencianatural. The 7th, B_Browser (created 2026-10-05), has no services

Every service uses template PREBUILT_V2. Git-sourced services auto-deploy on push to main; Hermes deploys by moving its GHCR image tag (scripts/deploy.sh); service restart and redeploy do not pull a new image

Service-data migration (env vars + config files move into Kubernetes Secrets on the server, irreversible) finished for all 6 projects 2026-10-02..06. Zeabur keeps no copy; the dated template exports in ~/Backups/zeabur are the only off-server copy
Zeabur's edge HTTP/3 stalled Safari after ~20-29 requests per connection (SocialAgenda, 2026-09-27); apps answer Alt-Svc: clear, and experiencianatural.com is proxied through Cloudflare

No token scopes exist; guardrail = global Claude Code hook plus deny rules blocking six destructive or spend-incurring verbs (deleting projects or services, renting servers, buying or renewing domains, topping up AI Hub)
CLI is logged in (verified 2026-10-06); live service state must be read with 'service get', not 'deployment list'
sources: zeabur auth status (plan shown in the login banner)

Runs k3s; each Zeabur project is a Kubernetes namespace; one static egress IP is shared by every service (Brevo and WAF allowlists key on it)

Single point of truth for all project secrets (Kubernetes Secrets) after the service-data migration: losing the SSH key or the server means restoring from the ~/Backups/zeabur exports

nodes.label: Zeabur destructive-verb guardrail
nodes.summary: Global Claude Code hook and deny rules that block the six Zeabur CLI verbs that delete infrastructure or spend money.
details: Hook script ~/.claude/hooks/block-zeabur-destructive.sh exists; settings.json mentions zeabur 26 times (deny rules plus the PreToolUse hook)

Blocked: deleting a project or a service, renting a server, purchasing or renewing a domain, adding AI Hub balance; the regex scans the whole command so bash -c, pinned npx versions and bare zeabur are caught
Fires even for allow-listed 'zeabur project *' and 'zeabur service *'; do not disable it: it is the primary spend and delete control on a personal account
A redundant copy is said to live in biglobster/.claude/settings.json (not checked)
It also fires on any shell command whose text merely contains those verbs, e.g. a script that documents them

zeabur_export_stream.py streams exports into a gpg pipe; only the .sha256 of that encrypted archive remains on disk

nodes.label: Host-side volume dump (backup-volumes.sh)
nodes.summary: Root script on the Frankfurt host that dumps every other project's data volume and uploads it to Google Drive.
details: Dumps: pg_dumpall for the Chatwoot, SocialAgenda and FlyWell Postgres, Redis SAVE, BigLobster sentinel SQLite via the backup API, tars of the idle Chrome/CDP volumes
Stages root-only in /var/backups/volumes/<stamp>, uploads with the host's own rclone to hermesdrive:/VolumeBackups/<stamp> and fails unless rclone check passes
First run 2026-10-06 (192 MB, all dumps verified); PR hermes-sandbox#415 merged 2026-10-06
A nightly 02:00 UTC /etc/cron.d entry is committed on branch ops/schedule-volume-backups but not on main in the local clone; install on the host not verified
No retention yet and nothing pages on failure; the Drive folder is unencrypted by choice and readable with the container's OAuth token
